description: Put on a plinth in front of a new social-housing block at Saint-Dalmas-de-Tende in 1984 by architect Thierry Valfort, who obtained the airframe from the Armee de l'Air with the help of Colonel Montagne; it arrived by road in two pieces and was reassembled on site by soldiers. Service record supplied by the Armee de l'Air: Meknes 1958-59, BA 701 Salon 1961, loaned to Israel 1961-63, Creil 1968-69, Orange 1970-73, Luxeuil 1976-84, stored at Chateaudun, struck off 22 April 1985 after 3,879 flying hours. Still in place and photographed in May 2025; no serial was published.
